question: R30 left two open items: (1) is the realised shear rate the nominal 2V/h_eff (abscissa), (2) how large is the rate-dependent flow stress (magnitude, not bound).

device.case: bit-identical to runs long_r29_* (rounds 24-30): 458 free disks, W=0.30, gap=0.15, P=10 kPa, mu_p=0.4, thickness=d, w=0.5 (plus w=0 crystal control)
device.instrumentation: profile_r31.ProfileAccumulator, 10 bins over [y_bottom+r, y_top-r], pooled over the whole 8-strain measurement window

decision_rules.abscissa_valid: gamma_dot_ratio in [0.90, 1.10] AND r2_linear >= 0.99 -> the nominal abscissa is correct; a mu deficit then cannot be blamed on I
decision_rules.abscissa_invalid: gamma_dot_ratio < 0.80 OR r2_linear < 0.95 -> the realised rate (or the profile) is not Couette; every I must be rescaled and the bound mu must be re-judged at I_measured
decision_rules.flow_stress_negligible: kinetic_share_p < 0.01 AND kinetic_share_tau < 0.01 -> the flow-stress term cannot account for the 3-4x deficit in b (R30 bound confirmed by direct measurement)
decision_rules.flow_stress_material: kinetic_share_tau > 0.10 -> the flow term is large enough to matter and b must be refitted with tau_total

predictions: P1 (from R30 line 5): the measured profile is Couette-like with gamma_dot_ratio > 0.8, so the 0.1 m/s apparent velocity scale in the KE is *not* the mean shear velocity (KE measures fluctuations, not the mean profile).
P2 (from R30's p_kin <= 0.132 % bound): the kinetic share of both p and tau is below 1 %.
P3: because P1 and P2 both hold, neither open item can rescue the 10 % acceptance; the anchor stays FAIL and the deficit is a contact-law/calibration issue.
P4: the shear is not localised into a band (10-bin mu_local stays finite and of the same order across the cell) - the crystal control w=0 is the plausible exception (basal slip).

falsifiers.P1: gamma_dot_ratio < 0.8 or r2 < 0.95 on any w=0.5 run
falsifiers.P4: mu_local varying by more than 3x across bins, or more than 2 empty bins

no_post_hoc_window_or_bin_choice: bins = 10 fixed here; fit band = central 60 % fixed here; measurement window = the pre-registered 8 strain, unchanged from R29.
